def prior_failure_binding(payloads, body):
    """Keep the actual failed capture as an original; the repaired capture cannot erase it."""
    need(PRIOR_FAILURE_MEMBER in payloads, 'original failed capture receipt missing')
    need(all(payloads[PRIOR_FAILURE_MEMBER][key] == value for key, value in PRIOR_FAILURE_PIN.items()),
         'original failed capture receipt differs')
    value = json.loads(body(PRIOR_FAILURE_MEMBER))
    need(value.get('package_complete') is False and value.get('phase') == 'scan'
         and value.get('candidate_adopted') is False, 'original scan failure was promoted')
    return dict(PRIOR_FAILURE_PIN, member=PRIOR_FAILURE_MEMBER, package_complete=False,
                phase='scan', candidate_adopted=False)
